Name: Crop Snacks
Author: BasiliskL
Description:
Adds snack items made by 2 machines, Fruit Snack Maker and Veggie Snack Maker. They make snacks at Iridium Quality.

Just have whatever fruit/veggie you wanna turn into a snack in you inventory and put the other item into the machine.

Snack: Place in machine (crop amount needed)

Crop Leather: Spices (5 crops)
Crop Bar: Pectin/Gelatin (5 crops)
Crop Field Snack: Field Snack (3 crops)
Candied Crop: 3 Sugar (1 crop)

and a drink
Crop Extract: Biodegradable Bottle (3 crops)

Both machines can also make a few Iridium Quality drinks in only a 1/2 hour:
Coffee: 8 Coffee Beans (50% chance for a second)
2 Ginger Ale: 5 Ginger + 1 sugar (2/3 chance of 1-2 extra)
Triple Shot Expresso: 3 Coffee

also Gummies made from a Crop Bar or Juicy Gummies made from 2 Crop Bars and a Crop Extract of the same kind.

Juicy Gummies, Crop Extract, and Candied Crop give buffs.

Biodegradable Bottle, Gelatin, and Spices can be bought from Pierre.
Pectin is milled from a Vanilla tree fruit.
Spices can be made by crafting Spice Paste and drying it in a furnace.

Also added recipe for Field Snack from 3 mixed seeds and mixed seeds can be eaten for a small amount of energy
